payload.description:
Replace external CONSOLE_WORKER_IMAGE_URI dependency with a CDK-managed Docker image asset for ConsoleRunWorker so sandbox/deploy updates are driven by code changes.

Scope:
- Update Amplify backend stack wiring for ConsoleRunWorker image source
- Keep production behavior explicit and predictable
- Remove/adjust scripts/docs that assume manual ECR push as primary path
- Validate TypeScript compile and sandbox workflow docs

Success criteria:
- Worker code changes produce a new Lambda container image asset on deploy
- No manual image URI rotation needed for normal deploy path
- Sandbox docs reflect the new workflow
payload.title: Migrate console worker Lambda to CDK-managed image assets
